descripcion: Glosario del flujo de propósitos. Cada definición está redactada a partir de la documentación de la fuente indicada («fuente» es un id de data/sources.json) y no añade valores. «nota» avisa cuando la documentación consultada no define el concepto.

terminos.definicion: Layer of loose, unconsolidated material covering solid rock.
Property of the ground that the TES instrument derives from the surface temperature measured from orbit. On this site it is used as an indicator of surface materials.
terminos.nota: The documentation consulted explains how the map is produced, but does not define the concept.

terminos.definicion: Final product of the Mini-RF radar. It compares the returned signal with the same sense of circular polarization as the transmitted one with the signal returned in the opposite sense.
An area near the lunar poles that is always in shadow. The LOLA altimeter studies them to identify possible sites with surface ice.
A measure of the intensity of neutron radiation, determined by the rate at which neutrons flow. The LEND detector measures the neutron flux leaving the lunar surface.
Neutrons with an energy just above the thermal range.
Inclination of the terrain. In the LOLA maps it is computed by fitting a plane to three consecutive laser shots.
Irregularity of the terrain over short distances. In the LOLA maps it is the deviation of heights from a plane fitted to three consecutive laser shots.
A map that stores the terrain height at each point. LOLA produces a high-resolution global topographic model of the Moon.
Fraction of rock that Diviner estimates at each map point, assuming that each point is a mixture of rock and regolith.
Difference between the temperature Diviner measures at midnight (adjusted for slope) and the temperature a model predicts for typical regolith.
Four values (S1 to S4) that describe the received radar signal. They are computed from calibrated Mini-RF data.
A feature of the infrared spectrum whose position Diviner maps in its level 3 products. On this site it is used as an indicator of mineral composition.
terminos.nota: The full definition in the source documentation has not been read.

terminos.definicion: Average sunlight received by the lunar surface, computed with a model from LOLA topography over a lunar precession cycle of about 18.6 years.
Average visibility of Earth from the lunar surface. Earth is considered visible if any part of its disk is not blocked by the terrain.
A measure of how much dust or ice in the atmosphere blocks light. The MCS instrument provides it in vertical profiles.
terminos.nota: The source page could not be re-read on the day it was consulted; the definition follows the product description.

terminos.definicion: Materials that evaporate quickly or readily turn into vapor.
The outermost region of a planet’s atmosphere.
A type of radar that produces images. RADARSAT-1 acquires them by day or night and in any weather.
According to NASA, a region of Mars with a landing site, a habitation site and sites of scientific interest.
Change in velocity. It is one of the parameters NASA’s Trajectory Browser uses to search for trajectories, together with the launch window and the duration.
NASA system for mission geometry and navigation.
